title: Agent management controls
findings: Agent management is incomplete where admins look for it: no pause or resume on the agent pages, "Resume all" skips General Employee, and revisions and per-agent routing cannot be used
Managers cannot compare agents or spot underperformers: agent cards and detail show configuration, not outcomes
ownedFiles: web/src/routes/AgentDetail.tsx (all sections except the connectors section)
spec:
Rules:
- Standard rules apply.
- Do not edit the connectors section of AgentDetail.tsx; another agent is rewriting it.
- Do not edit AgentController.java.
- Edit Permission.java only to clear the planned flag on agent:set_model_policy, and only if WP04 set it.

1) AgentsStrip bulk filter
- Replace the filter with: action === 'resume' ? a.status === 'paused' : a.status === 'active' && (includeGeneral || !a.fallback).
- Give each row its own pending state.
- The toast counts only real changes.

2) Pause and Resume buttons
- Add them to the AgentDetail header and to every Agents.tsx card.
- Gate them on agent:update and hide them for retired agents.
- Use the existing useSetAgentStatus. The per-id hooks are deleted by WP17.
- Pausing General Employee needs a confirm step that warns that unmatched requests will ask people to choose an agent.

3) Outcomes, using the WP19 contract GET /api/orchestrator/insights/agents?window=30d
- Gate on run:read.
- AgentDetail tiles: Success rate (30 days), Cost (30 days) and Runs (30 days). Keep the Connectors tile.
- Agents cards show two figures: success rate and 30-day cost.
- Show 'Not enough runs yet' when an agent has fewer than 5 finished runs.

4) Revisions
- New AgentRevisionsController: GET /api/agents/{id}/revisions (agent:read).
  - Returns view DTOs: revision, createdAt, createdBy, changed-field summary, usedByRuns flag.
  - Never returns JPA entities.
- AgentDetail Revisions card lists the revisions.
- Restore re-submits the old revision's prompt, goals, temperature, maxOutputTokens and maxSteps through the existing PUT /api/agents/{id}/configuration after a confirm step. This creates revision N+1.

5) Per-agent routing
- Extract the candidate-chain editor from ModelRouting.tsx into components/routing/PolicyEditor.tsx. ModelRouting uses it unchanged.
- AgentDetail embeds it, gated on agent:set_model_policy. Model pickers additionally need provider:read.
- Add DELETE /api/agents/{id}/model-policy to ModelPolicyController. In the UI it is the 'Use the workspace policy' option, which clears the agent's policy.
- Audit every model-policy change with the orchestrator AuditClient after commit.

Tests:
- AgentsStrip filter unit test.
- Revisions controller returns DTOs.
- DELETE clears the policy, and routing falls back to the workspace policy.
- PolicyEditor renders in both places.

Acceptance (live):
- Pause all, then Resume all, leaves General Employee active.
- AgentDetail shows Pause and the success tiles.
- Restoring revision 1 creates a new revision.
